flags.centroid: pin within 50 m of the centre of the market: probably a default point, not the site
flags.far_area: pin more than 15 km (or 1.5 times the area radius) from the centre of the place named in the address (only places and boundaries found inside the market)
flags.outside: pin more than 3 km outside the administrative boundary of the market (OpenStreetMap); markets named after a city use the city limits, so a suburb can be outside
flags.range: latitude or longitude out of range
flags.shared: the same pin is used by projects with different names
